item_safeword_system.label: Safeword System
item_safeword_system.tooltip: Select the primary pre-agreed mechanism to slow down, pause, or immediately stop a scene.

item_aftercare_preferences.label: Aftercare Preferences
item_aftercare_preferences.tooltip: Physical and emotional care desired immediately after a scene ends to support grounding and recovery.

item_medical_allergies.label: Medical restrictions, allergies & physical conditions
item_medical_allergies.tooltip: Note allergies (e.g., latex, nickel, paraffin), asthma, joint injuries, circulatory conditions, or relevant medications.

item_psychological_triggers.label: Psychological triggers & emotional boundaries
item_psychological_triggers.tooltip: Topics, words, scenarios, or sensory cues that must be strictly avoided to protect emotional well-being.

item_cuddling_affection.label: Cuddling & physical affection
item_cuddling_affection.tooltip: Affectionate touch, holding, kissing, and physical closeness before, during, or after a scene.

item_oral_stimulation.label: Oral stimulation
item_oral_stimulation.tooltip: Consensual oral sex as part of foreplay or the main intimate interaction.

item_sensory_massage.label: Sensory massage
item_sensory_massage.tooltip: Intentional slow touch, varied pressure, oils, or textures for warm-up and body awareness.

item_teasing_anticipation.label: Teasing & anticipation
item_teasing_anticipation.tooltip: Gradually building desire and suspense through light touch, pauses, and verbal or physical teasing.

item_edging.label: Edging (Orgasm delay)
item_edging.tooltip: Bringing a partner repeatedly close to climax and pausing stimulation to heighten or prolong the response.

item_pace_control.label: Pace & intensity control
item_pace_control.tooltip: Explicitly guiding rhythm, breathing, and intensity progression throughout the encounter.

item_dirty_talk.label: Dirty talk / Erotic communication
item_dirty_talk.tooltip: Explicit verbal expression, consensual commands, or erotic narration during play.

item_cuffs_light.label: Cuffs & light restraint
item_cuffs_light.tooltip: Wrist or ankle restraint using padded, leather, or metal cuffs while preserving circulation and joint comfort.

item_rope_shibari.label: Rope bondage (Shibari / Kinbaku)
item_rope_shibari.tooltip: Functional or artistic rope tying with attention to anatomical safety and nerve compression avoidance.

item_blindfold.label: Blindfold
item_blindfold.tooltip: Temporarily blocking sight to heighten other senses and consensual anticipation.

item_gag.label: Gag
item_gag.tooltip: Oral restraint limiting speech; requires continuous airway monitoring and an agreed non-verbal safeword signal.

item_collar_leash.label: Collar & leash
item_collar_leash.tooltip: Symbolic or functional use of a collar and leash; never pull in ways that compress the trachea or neck.

item_suspension_bondage.label: Suspension bondage
item_suspension_bondage.tooltip: Partial or full body suspension using rope and load-rated rig points; requires advanced training and active monitoring.

item_sensory_deprivation.label: Sensory deprivation
item_sensory_deprivation.tooltip: Combining blindfolds, ear protection, or tactile isolation to reduce external sensory input.

item_cage_confinement.label: Cage or confinement
item_cage_confinement.tooltip: Consensual time inside a cage or enclosed space with continuous supervision and immediate release capability.

item_bondage_materials.label: Preferred bondage materials
item_bondage_materials.tooltip: Select materials you feel comfortable with regarding skin texture, safety, and hygiene.

item_spanking_manual.label: Manual spanking (Open hand)
item_spanking_manual.tooltip: Open-hand spanking focused on padded, anatomically safe areas such as buttocks and upper thighs.

item_paddle.label: Paddle
item_paddle.tooltip: Broad, flat impact using a leather, wood, or silicone paddle on safe muscular zones.

item_flogger.label: Flogger
item_flogger.tooltip: Multi-tailed implement capable of everything from gentle warm-up thudding to intense impact.

item_cane.label: Cane
item_cane.tooltip: Thin, rigid implement delivering sharp, stinging linear impact that requires precise aim.

item_crop.label: Riding crop
item_crop.tooltip: Flexible shaft with a leather popper used for targeted stings, sound, and visual or tactile play.

item_face_slapping.label: Face slapping
item_face_slapping.tooltip: Light to moderate facial impact; requires strict prior alignment to avoid ears, nose, eyes, and jaw joints.

item_impact_tools.label: Preferred impact tools
item_impact_tools.tooltip: Indicate which implements or surfaces best fit your physical and sensory comfort.

item_hot_wax.label: Hot wax
item_hot_wax.tooltip: Dripping low-temperature body-safe candles (cosmetic paraffin or soy), carefully controlling pour distance and heat.

item_ice_play.label: Ice & temperature play
item_ice_play.tooltip: Applying ice cubes or chilled implements to the skin, alone or alternated with warmth.

item_nipple_clamps.label: Nipple clamps & clothespins
item_nipple_clamps.tooltip: Applying adjustable pressure to the nipples; periodic release is recommended to maintain healthy circulation.

item_scratching.label: Scratching
item_scratching.tooltip: Superficial skin scratching with nails or textured tools without breaking the skin.

item_biting.label: Biting
item_biting.tooltip: Consensual biting on agreed body areas while managing pressure and visible marks.

item_electro_stimulation.label: Electro-stimulation (E-stim)
item_electro_stimulation.tooltip: Purpose-built erotic electro-play devices used strictly below the waist; unsafe with pacemakers or cardiac conditions.

item_play_piercing.label: Needles / Play piercing
item_play_piercing.tooltip: Temporary piercing using sterile single-use needles; requires strict asepsis, sharps disposal, and specialized skill.

item_ds_dynamic.label: D/s dynamic (Scene or 24/7)
item_ds_dynamic.tooltip: Consensual authority exchange limited to scene time or structured as ongoing lifestyle agreements.

item_domestic_servitude.label: Domestic servitude
item_domestic_servitude.tooltip: Serving, tending, or performing household tasks for a partner within a playful or structured service dynamic.

item_pet_play.label: Pet play
item_pet_play.tooltip: Roleplay in which one participant adopts pet-like mannerisms under the care or guidance of a handler.

item_consensual_discipline.label: Consensual discipline & punishment
item_consensual_discipline.tooltip: Pre-negotiated rules, tasks, and consensual corrective consequences within clear limits.

item_orgasm_control.label: Orgasm control & denial
item_orgasm_control.tooltip: Granting, delaying, or restricting climax according to mutually agreed scene or dynamic rules.

item_verbal_humiliation.label: Consensual verbal humiliation
item_verbal_humiliation.tooltip: Pre-agreed teasing or degrading language strictly confined to scene play, steering clear of listed personal triggers.

item_body_worship.label: Body worship
item_body_worship.tooltip: Focused sensory devotion and adoration toward specific body parts (e.g., feet, thighs, torso) via touch and kisses.

item_gear_leather.label: Leather gear
item_gear_leather.tooltip: Wearing leather garments, harnesses, jackets, or accessories for aesthetic or sensory play.

item_gear_latex.label: Latex & rubber
item_gear_latex.tooltip: Form-fitting latex or PVC wear; always verify potential latex allergies beforehand.

item_gear_lingerie_stockings.label: Lingerie, stockings & heels
item_gear_lingerie_stockings.tooltip: Incorporating stylized lingerie, thigh-high stockings, garters, or heels into visual presentation.

item_gear_uniforms_costumes.label: Uniforms & costumes
item_gear_uniforms_costumes.tooltip: Themed attire or uniforms used to establish consensual roleplay atmosphere.

item_gear_cross_dressing.label: Cross-dressing
item_gear_cross_dressing.tooltip: Wearing clothing associated with another gender expression during intimate play or roleplay.

item_gear_toys_vibrators.label: Toys, plugs & vibrators
item_gear_toys_vibrators.tooltip: Using vibrators, dildos, anal plugs, or stimulators made from body-safe, properly sanitized materials.

item_breathplay_choking.label: Breathplay / Choking
item_breathplay_choking.tooltip: RACK WARNING (High Risk): Carries serious risks of hypoxia, vascular injury, fainting, and cardiac arrest. Never engage without deep safety education, an active non-verbal drop signal, and explicit informed consent.

item_fear_play.label: Fear play
item_fear_play.tooltip: RACK WARNING (High Risk): Controlled induction of adrenaline and startle responses. Can trigger panic or dissociation; requires unmistakable safewords, continuous check-ins, and dedicated aftercare.

item_cnc_roleplay.label: Consensual Non-Con (CNC)
item_cnc_roleplay.tooltip: RACK WARNING (High Risk): Roleplay depicting non-consent built upon explicit, revocable prior agreement. Requires clear scripting, an unmistakable hard-stop safeword, and dedicated emotional aftercare.

item_blood_cutting.label: Bloodplay & cutting
item_blood_cutting.tooltip: RACK WARNING (High Risk): Carries risks of infection, bloodborne pathogen transmission, hemorrhage, and permanent scarring. Requires medical-grade sterilization, single-use blades, and prior STI/bloodborne testing.
